text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary /v2/generate p95 latency +35% vs baseline over 5m. Autorevert candidate: roll back to v3.4.2 (r2024-03-14). Suggested actions: (1) execute canary-only rollback, (2) throttle, or (3) ignore. telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/alerts/1718349999

Alice: seeing same in Grafana — EU region p95 is spiking, some requests hitting client timeouts. Any idea which change caused this?

Bob: deploybot's threshold is 25% p95 by default. This one crossed 35%, so it flagged. Autorevert is enabled but requires operator confirmation for canary->prod flows.

Claire: from a release coordination POV, prefer a targeted canary rollback (10% slice) to v3.4.2 while we investigate. Keep prod pinned. We'll want a short release-note patch if we do this.

Dave: I'll prepare the rollback command and runbook. Proposed command:
```
releases rollback --to v3.4.2 --scope canary --selectors region=eu --reason "p95 spike"
```
Will wait 2m for objections.

Erin: Support reports 4 tickets mentioning timeouts in the last 10m (cust IDs 1234, 5678). If SRE confirms, we should rollback. Throttling risks queueing and tail latency.

Bob: agreed with Erin — throttling likely makes tails worse. Rollback looks safest.

Alice: +1 — go ahead. I'll prep the internal comm and a short customer note template. Please ensure we do not touch prod routing.

Claire: I'll draft the customer-facing blurb: "We rolled back a canary model due to a performance regression; there was no exposure of customer data and no changes to model outputs for production traffic." Adding legal tag for sign-off.

legal-bot: Reminder: include exact audit log entries from the rollback and confirm no data-plane keys were rotated. Tag @legal if any customer-sensitive wording.

Dave: executing now. Pasting run output (truncated):
```
$ releases rollback --to v3.4.2 --scope canary --selectors region=eu --reason "p95 spike"
Rolling back canary slice [eu] to v3.4.2...
Step 1/3: draining new-model connections -> OK
Step 2/3: updating routing -> OK
Step 3/3: verification -> p95 back to baseline (within 1m)
Rollback complete. audit_id=rb-20240402-8421
```

Alice: saw the audit_id. Confirming: p95 returned to baseline in telemetry. :thumbsup:

Erin: I pushed a short note to the support queue and flagged impacted tickets.

Claire: I'll append a short release-note patch and mark it "post-deploy follow-up". Follow-up ticket: ENG-4567 to investigate regression root cause, link to logs.

Bob: great. Next steps: (1) keep prod pinned, (2) run perf regression bisect on the canary diff, (3) prep a hotfix candidate if we identify the change.

Dave: creating postmortem stub and adding the rollback audit log. Closing this thread after ENG-4567 gets a first-pass by EOD.

Alice: thanks all. If anything new pops up I'll re-open.

deploy-bot: NOTE: autorevert suppressed for this rollout (operator override present).
